reviews.t: Good drill but didnt last long for me.
reviews.x: I love this drill it work for my aryclics and I'm a beginner so it was easy to use and you can set your speed as well.  Update: less then a month and its giving out already but hey it did a few jobs 2 fills and 4 full sets so i guess i got what i paid 4 with a low price cant expect anything else.. Just wish i didnt have to buy unless its a 6 mos atleast but less then a month well took care and still gave out🙄🤦🏾

This product is like the ones my nail tech has, I’m not paying someone else to do my nail anymore. Built with good quality material, ergonomic, easy to handle. Comes with a bunch of “tips” to get the buffing, and shaping of your nail on point! Comes with a little brush, that’s soft and super useful, charger and everything you need. I loved it.

reviews.t: Fire hazard & total piece of garbage
reviews.x: This nail drill is very cheaply made.. I’ve had it for about 5 months, but have only used it maybe 3 or 4 times. The casing that covers the little circuit board fell off after the first use, so the wires were totally exposed. Today I pulled it out of the box, plugged it in and when I picked it up to start using it, there was a big spark as the wires disconnected from the circuit board and it broke into two pieces.. Don’t waste your money!

I really liked it. I did my manicure myself and its looks really good. Really excited! It has 2 ways switch which allows you to work clock wise and against the clock. Really helps and I did not have to be an acrobat to do my nails now.
When it was working it did a good job but Not worth your money worked for 3 uses in the time I've had it and stopped working!
The first time i used this product the usb connector broke. Was not able to use at all.
This drill is garbage!!! It stopped working after 1 month!!! Don’t waste ur money!

My daughter use to get her nails done at the nail salon before Covid-19 happened. I decided to buy her everything to do her own nails at home, was able to grab most in the store but they didn't carry an electric nail drill at a decent price like this one is! My daughter learned how to use the electric nail drill in no time and has even been practicing on my nails. She enjoys it so much, she says she's going to continue doing her own nails and offer to do her friend's nails when she is allowed ar

Love, love, LOVE this product! It is so easy to use and does a great job whatever it is! I have done with tips and without tips all with dip powder nails! Great shaping tool, amazing at fixing mistakes and I cant stress enough about how easy to use it is! I have played around with it a lot and have never had to go over the lowest setting, but if you do, be careful it will take a couple layers of skin!!  I am having too much fun and am never going to pay someone to do my nails again! I got it 4 d

This is my first review and I’m glad because I believe that people should know this is a good product. The drill is lightweight and it comes with strong bits. The bits come in little containers for organization and the drill itself comes with a cable. You will need a wall plug to charge your phone for the cable to connect to and power your drill which is pretty cool. The packaging for me personally came well. I hope this review helps people :)

Like many women, I had to start doing my natural nails at home because this world is a mess. Got this cute little drill because I wanted to gel my nails and it really is perfect. It’s palm-sized and comes with tons of little nail drill bits (same kind as at the professional nail salons). I’ve done my nails SEVERAL times with it already and it’s powerful enough to get the job done. I’d recommend this for sure.

reviews.t: i would buy again if god forbid something were to ever go wrong with it.
reviews.x: Actually, I hadn’t tried this kind of cream before was pleasantly surprised fab product removes unwanted hair in a jiffy great value. There was no irritation at all.Because I was sensitive to the fragrance, this product has natural smell.So it helped me get rid of the fragrance irritation successfully. If you don’t have time to get to the beauty salon this does a professional job at a fraction of the cost.

reviews.t: Right what you need for at home manicure
reviews.x: I don’t know why I didn’t get this before! I’m still learning all the uses, I look at videos to learn need things. It’s perfect to have at home at this crazy times when I don’t feel comfortable going to the salon. It has many different parts and uses, it’s perfect size and weight to do my own manicure/ pedicure. I get excited every time I have to use it, I feel like a profesional.  Plus I love the color

Professional nail polishing tool! I have been home for too long time due to the Virus lock down. No nail beauty store open. So I purchased this tool to do nail by myself. This is the first time to use it. If there’s a detail instruction, it would be awesome. But not a big deal, I watched Youtobe video to get some information of using it. Easy. Works good on me. Anyway, I’m satisfied with this purchase.

[[VIDEOID:18e20e8d66b321ee7b22fe9b8b725040]] The reviews seemed like it would be a good beginner drill but the first time using it sucked. It constantly stopped the reverse didn’t work properly as well I'm so disappointed in this product. It also started making noise and was just so awful i just ended up putting it away and using a file. This is beyond cheap. Guess you get what you pay for.

reviews.t: Nice price, easy to use & beginner friendly controlling the speed
reviews.x: This drill is perfect, it has everything you need and It's not noisy! Definitely worth the price. I originally received a defective drill, but as soon as I send an email they responded within a few minutes. They're costumer service is awesome! They sent me a new drill (with the all the accessories it came with) in 2 days! Plus I got to keep the first drill and the accessories.

I’ve had my drill a few months and don’t use it much. I picked it up yesterday and it’s broken. The backs of the switch kept coming off and I had to use nail glue to put it together and now all of a sudden I’m not able to put my bits into the drill. Not understanding how this has happened already. Wouldn’t recommend getting unless you want a drill to play with.

I’ve been wanting to order this for a while now and finally pulled the trigger. I love it! It works really well and it came with a variety of attachments for anything you need as well as a good amount of the disposable tips. You can control the speed which is great as well. My friend does nails and I already told her to get one! Love it!

reviews.t: Great! This drill is easy to use no matter how much or how little experience you have.
reviews.x: I haven’t been getting my nails done for almos 4 months and even though nails salon are open now i still don’t feel save to go get me nails and I have to say I was a little bit nervous to use this since I've never used a power drill before. It really wasn't as bad as I thought it would be. Is super easy to use and does a great job.

I give it five stars only by it serves its purpose! This is definitely a drill for beginners and great for kids that are interested in doing nails. The one draw back is the cord situation you will need an extension cord, but beyond that a perfect lil at home drill to do small care such as file the cuticle area and side walls.

I do my mani/pedi at home and I use a rotary tool like at the salon and this one gets the job done. Its very simple and slender not bulky in your hands for easy use. It has great power and for the price compared to the more expensive rotary tool kits this one is great. Definitely recommend for DIY-ers or beginners.

I really enjoys this drill. Super light weight an easy to use. However I’ve used it a handful of times and it has just completely fallen apart. Where the power on off switch is it broke the wiring ending up falling completely off the power section. It was a bummer. Idk if I just got a faulty on or what.

In less than three months the cord only works in a certain direction. The manufacturer hasn't answered six emails ,and Amazon has done nothing, escalated twice, never heard from, 2 chats no solution. All I want is another cord!!!!!!!!!!!! For almost $20 I should get more use than less than 3 months

I’m impressed switch this little device. With lockdown situation it was impossible to get pedicures done for a long time so I ordered this kit.  I was impressed with power this device has. It provided very good results. Whole bunch of attachments made it possible to do a precise job.

Don't waste your money,I  have power cord issues all the time and it continously stops on me. I would not recommend this for beginners because I find it to be very frustrating. This product needs a lot of improvement. I'm buying a new today from another company...

claims.text: Many customers find the drill easy to use and beginner-friendly, praising its speed settings and included bits.
Several reviewers report the drill stopped working or broke after only a few uses or a short time.
Customers appreciate the good value and low price for an at-home nail tool.
Some reviewers describe the build quality as cheap, with exposed wiring or broken connectors.
Users like that it comes with many bits and accessories, comparing it to professional salon tools.
